changes.text: 魏公子无忌带着百余乘车骑出了魏都大梁，准备去秦军阵前拼命，与赵国同归于尽。车过城东的夷门，他停下来见守门的老人侯嬴，把这打算原原本本告诉了他。侯嬴只送了一句「公子勉之矣，老臣不能從」。车队走出几里，《史记》写无忌「心不快」；他掉转车头，回来问侯嬴。

Prince Wuji of Wei rode out of Daliang, the Wei capital, with a hundred-odd chariots and horsemen, intending to hurl himself at the Qin army and die alongside the state of Zhao. Passing the Yimen, the eastern gate of the city, he stopped to see Hou Ying, the aged gatekeeper there, and told him the plan outright. Hou Ying saw him off with a single line — "Push on, my lord; I am old and cannot follow you". The column had gone a few li when the Records of the Grand Historian has Wuji "troubled in his heart"; he turned the chariots around and came back to ask Hou Ying whether he had failed him in some way.
难处摆在那里：秦军围住赵都邯郸，无忌自己的国君魏安釐王已经派将军晋鄙率十万大军救赵，却传令止步，把军队留在邺观望。无忌手里没有兵，只有百余乘车骑和一群门客。去是送死；不去，邯郸旦暮可下，而他的姐姐是赵国平原君的夫人。

The difficulty was plain to see. Qin forces had invested Handan, the Zhao capital. King Anxi of Wei, Wuji's own king, had already sent General Jin Pi with a hundred thousand troops to relieve Zhao, then ordered him to halt and camp at Ye and watch. Wuji had no army, only a hundred-odd chariots and a band of retainers. Riding out meant dying for nothing. Staying meant Handan could fall any day — and his own sister was the wife of Lord Pingyuan of Zhao.
秦昭王在破赵长平军之后，进兵围邯郸。无忌的姐姐是平原君夫人，她几次写信给魏王和无忌求救。魏王于是派将军晋鄙将十万众救赵。

King Zhao of Qin, having destroyed Zhao's army at Changping, marched on and laid siege to Handan. Wuji's sister was the wife of Lord Pingyuan. She wrote letter after letter to the king of Wei and to Wuji begging for help, and the king of Wei sent General Jin Pi with a hundred thousand troops to rescue Zhao.
无忌几次请求魏王，宾客辩士说王万端，魏王畏秦，终不听。无忌自度无法从魏王那里得到兵，「計不獨生而令趙亡」——不能自己活着而让赵国灭亡，于是约集宾客，备好百余乘车骑，打算带门客去拼死。这就是他出城那天的打算。

Wuji petitioned the king of Wei several times, and his retainers, debaters and persuaders alike, argued the case from every angle. The king of Wei feared Qin and never relented. Wuji judged that he would never get troops out of the king, and decided he would not "live on alone and let Zhao perish." So he gathered his retainers, readied a hundred-odd chariots, and meant to lead his men into the Qin lines to die with Zhao. That was the plan he rode out with.
无忌到邺，假传魏王令来代晋鄙。晋鄙合了符，仍有疑心，举手看着他说：我如今拥十万之众屯在边境，是国家重任，一辆车来接替我，是怎么回事？打算不听。朱亥从袖中抽出四十斤铁椎，椎杀晋鄙。无忌于是接管军队，下令：父子都在军中的，父亲回家；兄弟都在军中的，兄长回家；独子没有兄弟的，回去奉养父母。选出八万人，进兵击秦军。

At Ye, Wuji presented a forged order from the king of Wei and announced that he was replacing Jin Pi. Jin Pi matched the two halves of the tally and was still suspicious. He raised his hand and looked hard at Wuji: "I hold a hundred thousand men on the frontier, a grave charge for the state, and now a single carriage comes to relieve me. What is the meaning of this?" He was on the point of refusing. Zhu Hai drew from his sleeve an iron mace weighing forty catties and killed him. Wuji took over the army and gave orders in the camp: fathers and sons both serving, the father goes home; brothers both serving, the elder brother goes home; an only son with no brothers goes home to care for his parents. From the men left he picked eighty thousand, and advanced on the Qin army.
另一种做法是继续等魏王回心转意。但平原君已经说邯郸旦暮降秦。作者推断：拖下去的代价由城里的人承担；他选的不是一个干净的选项，而是当时能改变局面的一种做法，代价是杀本国将军、失信于魏王。

The other course was to keep waiting for the king of Wei to change his mind. But Lord Pingyuan had already said that Handan might surrender to Qin any day. On this reading, the price of holding back would be paid by the people inside the walls, and what Wuji chose was not a clean option; it was one that could change the situation, at the price of killing his own general and losing the trust of his king.

司马迁怎么看待此事？太史公说自己过大梁，特意去寻夷门；他称无忌为信陵君，说无忌结交岩穴隐者、不耻下交，「名冠諸侯，不虛耳」。作者认为，这份褒扬落在无忌敬重侯嬴这类隐士的一端，而不在矫令杀将上。代价也没有就此结束：无忌留赵十年，后来秦攻魏，他在赵国结交的隐士毛公、薛公劝他：公子在赵国受重视、名闻诸侯，「徒以有魏也」——只因背后有魏国。他立刻归国为将，率五国之兵破秦；秦用重金收买晋鄙的门客毁谤他，魏王果然派人代将，他谢病饮酒，四年后病酒而死。他死后秦攻魏，拔二十城，此后十八年，秦国俘虏了魏国后来的国君。一种解释是，这段收尾把无忌的存亡与魏国的存亡写在了一起。

What did Sima Qian make of it? The Grand Historian writes that he passed through Daliang and made a point of finding the Yimen. Calling Wuji by his title, Lord Xinling, he says Wuji's readiness to seek out recluses in mountain caves and to befriend men beneath him had good cause, and that his name stood first among the lords — no empty fame. One reading is that this praise lands on the end where Wuji honored recluses like Hou Ying, not on the forged order and the slain general. And the costs did not stop there. Wuji stayed in Zhao ten years. When Qin attacked Wei, Master Mao and Master Xue, two recluses he had befriended in Zhao, told him that he was valued in Zhao and known among the lords only because he had Wei behind him. He went home at once to command Wei's army and led the forces of five states to defeat Qin. Qin then spent heavy sums of gold buying off Jin Pi's former retainers to slander him; the king of Wei did send a replacement to take over the army, and Wuji excused himself on illness and took to drink, dying of it four years later. After his death Qin attacked Wei and took twenty cities, and eighteen years later captured a later king of Wei. On one interpretation, this closing episode writes Wuji's survival and Wei's survival on the same line.
本文所引兵数（晋鄙所将十万众、选出的八万人）都取自本传的记述。
The troop figures cited here — Jin Pi's hundred thousand and the eighty thousand picked men — are taken from this biography's account.
本文只依据《史记·魏公子列传》；对话出自史家记述，未必逐字；「心不快」「意驕矜」「立自責」是叙述用语，而非实录心理。

This piece draws only on the "Biography of the Prince of Wei" in the Records of the Grand Historian; the speeches come from the historian's account and need not be verbatim. "Troubled in his heart," "showed a self-satisfied look," and "at once blamed himself" are narrative wording, not recorded states of mind.
一、先把送死式的冲锋换成具体计算：手里的资源投进去能换来什么；二、动手前为“对方不配合”备好人手和止损点（侯嬴让无忌带上朱亥）；三、事成之后认下对自己这方的亏欠，不把功劳记在自己账上（门客劝后无忌自责）。

First, replace the death-ride with concrete arithmetic: what would the resources at hand actually buy? Second, before acting, line up a person and a stop-loss for the case where the other party will not cooperate — Hou Ying had Wuji bring the butcher Zhu Hai. Third, after it works, put the debt to your own side on your own account and do not bank the credit — as Wuji did once the retainer spoke to him.

dispositions.rationale: 英文改为 Prince Wuji of Wei 并注明 Daliang 是魏都；中文同步写作“魏都大梁”，两种语言都让读者看出叫停救兵的是他自己的国君。大梁有魏国先王宗庙，据此称为魏都。

evidence.quote: 使秦破大梁而夷先王之宗廟

dispositions.rationale: 英文改为 whether he had failed him in some way，与原文“我豈有所失哉”的意思一致，也与 analysis.0 对齐。

evidence.quote: 我豈有所失哉？復引車還，問侯生

dispositions.rationale: hook.1 英文写成 King Anxi of Wei, Wuji's own king，平原君写成 Lord Pingyuan of Zhao；中文同步写出“无忌自己的国君魏安釐王”。context.0 和 context.3 的英文统一改用 the king of Wei，不再换用 King Anxi 或 the King of Wei 等叫法。

evidence.quote: 公子姊為趙惠文王弟平原君夫人

dispositions.rationale: 英文首句改为 presented a forged order from the king of Wei，补回“矫”这层意思，与中文“假传魏王令”一致。
把“作者推断”的标签提到“拖下去的代价由城里的人承担”之前，平原君的话只作为记载保留；英文把 On this reading 移到 the price of holding back 之前。

evidence.quote: 今邯鄲旦暮降秦而魏救不至

dispositions.rationale: 被俘的国君改称“魏国后来的国君”，英文改为 a later king of Wei，以区别于与公子同年去世的安釐王。
按规则 7 和规则 5，不能删段，字段也不能为空，因此改写本段。删去与正文不符的“纪年只用魏安釐王二十年”，只留一句正文确实用到的兵数来源说明（十万众、八万人），中英同步，ev 补入 E9。

evidence.quote: 魏王使將軍晉鄙將十萬眾救趙

dispositions.rationale: 中文删去“纪年只用原文，不换算公元”，英文删去 Dates follow the original… 一句，其余不变。
中文删去“主动”二字，与史例“门客劝后才自责”一致，也与英文对齐；英文原句无误，按原文重新给出。

evidence.quote: 公子聞之，意驕矜而有自功之色
